items.q: Snowballs and snowbanking over inferior pars plana with macular oedema in a 25 year old is what?
items.exp: Vitreous centred inflammation with exudates characterises intermediate disease; MS, sarcoid and Lyme associations need review while steroids target oedema threatening reading vision.
r: Incorrect. Anterior disease cells the chamber.
Incorrect. Serous detaches macula without snow.
items.kp: Snow low in vitreous: intermediate uveitis.

items.q: Focal retinal whitening beside an old pigmented scar with dense overlying vitritis is classic for what?
items.exp: Satellite reactivation edges glow like headlights in fog; antiparasitics with steroids heal while steroids alone flare parasites. Congenital bilateral scars differ from acquired unifocal disease.
r: Incorrect. CMV lacks old scars, spreads haemorrhagic.
Incorrect. Diabetes dots and blots bilaterally.
items.kp: Old scar with new fluffy neighbour: toxoplasmosis.

items.q: Pizza pie haemorrhagic retinal necrosis in advanced AIDS with CD4 under 50 indicates what?
items.exp: CMV creeps perivascularly with haemorrhage and granular edges toward zones threatening fovea and nerve; systemic therapy with immune restoration halts march while intravitreal bridges sight threatening lesions.
r: Correct. CMV pizza pie in AIDS.
items.kp: Haemorrhagic pizza in AIDS retina: CMV.

items.q: Oral plus genital ulcers with hypopyon uveitis and retinal vasculitis defines which disease?
items.exp: Silk route vasculitis occludes retinal vessels blinding rapidly; pathergy, erythema nodosum and HLA-B51 support while biologics rescue refractory eyes. VKH instead vitiligos with detachments.
items.kp: Two ulcer sites plus hypopyon: Behcet.

items.q: Bilateral exudative detachments with disc swelling, meningismus, vitiligo and poliosis after flu suggests what?
o: Vogt Koyanagi Harada disease needing prolonged steroids
items.exp: Autoimmune melanocyte assault swells choroid detaching retina bilaterally; early high dose steroids with slow taper and steroid sparing agents prevent sunset glow depigmentation and chronicity.
items.kp: Flu then white lashes plus bilateral detachments: VKH.

items.q: Post traumatic eye pain with hypopyon, ring infiltrate risk and fulminant course within hours suggests which organism pattern?
o: Bacillus cereus fulminant endophthalmitis after soil contaminated injury
items.exp: Bacillus toxins melt eyes within a day of farm injuries; emergent vitrectomy with intravitreal antibiotics offers the only salvage while prophylaxis starts at primary repair.
items.kp: Soil injury eye dead by morning: Bacillus.

items.q: Endogenous endophthalmitis with bilateral vitritis in a diabetic with Klebsiella liver abscess spreads by what route?
o: Haematogenous septic emboli needing blood cultures with systemic plus intravitreal therapy
items.exp: Bacteraemia seeds choroid bilaterally; source control (drain abscess), systemic antibiotics and ophthalmic injections run together while diabetes control aids. No wound exists.
items.kp: Liver abscess plus bilateral pus eyes: blood spread.

items.q: Acute retinal necrosis is distinguished by which features and needs what?
o: Herpetic peripheral confluent whitening with occlusive vasculitis needing high dose aciclovir plus steroids
items.exp: Varicella and simplex necrotise periphery circumferentially toward fovea with vitritis; antivirals halt march while laser barricades detachments and fellow eye prophylaxis continues.
items.kp: Peripheral retina whitening fast: herpetic necrosis.

items.q: Cystoid macular oedema as a complication of uveitis is best detected and treated how?
o: OCT petaloid leakage with periocular or systemic steroids and immunosuppression
items.exp: OCT quantifies cystic thickening driving vision loss while angiography leaks petaloid; treating inflammation plus oedema (steroids, anti VEGF debates, vitrectomy selected) restores reading.
items.kp: Uveitic blur with petaloid leak: macular oedema.

items.q: Toxic anterior segment syndrome differs from endophthalmitis chiefly by what?
o: Sterile postoperative inflammation within 24 hours with limbus to limbus oedema, no vitritis, from irrigant or instrument residue
items.exp: TASS erupts same day from endotoxins or polishing compounds with wall to wall corneal oedema but quiet vitreous, settling with intensive steroids; endophthalmitis brews days later with vitritis needing antibiotics.
r: Correct. Day one sterile wall oedema.
items.kp: Day one white wall, clear vitreous: toxic, not infective.
